description: Every pin in the repository, proposed as one weekly pull request, sitedrift, Astro and each major on their own, security fixes at once.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A fix for an advisory GitHub reports opens at once, outside the schedule and the release-age hold.

packageRules.description: config:best-practices holds npm releases three days through security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm, a package rule a top-level value does not reach; npm gets the same 7 days as everything else.
Everything short of a major moves together, digests included, so a week's updates are one pull request.
Astro and its integrations release together and are tested together.
sitedrift is bundled into the production edge functions, so it comes alone and is merged by hand.
Node moves as one update across mise.toml, mise.lock and .nvmrc (Cloudflare Pages reads .nvmrc); checks:repo-policy fails while the pins differ.
Held at TypeScript 6: the audits and Astro's language tools call the compiler API that TypeScript 7 does not ship (docs/Dependencies.md).
@types/node and npm follow the Node major in .nvmrc, so their majors move with a Node major (docs/Dependencies.md).
